stderr_matches: \[kuna --jobs\] note: a synthesized structure has a field type another process cannot rebuild
stderr_absent: have no result because their worker process failed

notes: pebnames creates the PEB type the first time a function reads gs:[0x60], so under --jobs only the worker that decompiled store_a holds it, and store_a's structure has a PEB * field. The parent sees the field type has no load-time recipe and names the structures by the one-worker serial path; no worker tries to install a table it cannot build, and every function keeps its body (the kuna-cli integration test compares the document with --jobs 1).
